payload.core_mechanism_summary: Outer loop over target votes x; for each x, greedily cap opponents' votes by buying their cheapest voters, then fill remaining needed votes with cheapest available voters globally.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts voters by cost per party and globally. For each possible final vote count, it greedily picks cheapest options to reduce opponent counts and to boost party 1, taking the minimum total cost. This matches greedy sorting order.
